title: Identification of cellular proteins associated with human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) DNA replication suggests novel cellular and viral interactions.
one_liner_zh: 该文用aniPOND方法鉴定HCMV复制时与新生病毒DNA结合的细胞蛋白，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但无AI/物理模拟建模，且非TF-DNA特异性结合体系，仅部分相关。
abstract: Upon entry of Human cytomegalovirus (HCMV) into the host cell, the viral genome is transported to the nucleus where it serves as a template for transcription and genome replication. Production of new viral genomes is a coordinated effort between viral and cellular proteins. While the core replication proteins are encoded by the virus, additional cellular proteins support the process of genome synthesis. We used accelerated native isolation of proteins on nascent DNA (aniPOND) to study protein dynamics on nascent viral DNA during HCMV infection. Using this method, we identified specific viral and cellular proteins that are associated with nascent viral DNA. These included transcription factors, transcriptional regulators, DNA damage and repair factors, and chromatin remodeling complexes. The association of these identified proteins with viral DNA was confirmed by immunofluorescent imaging, chromatin-immunoprecipitation analyses, and shRNA knockdown experiments. These data provide evidence for the requirement of cellular factors involved in HCMV replication.
abstract_zh: 人巨细胞病毒（HCMV）进入宿主细胞后，病毒基因组被转运至细胞核，在那里作为转录和基因组复制的模板。新病毒基因组的产生是病毒蛋白与细胞蛋白协同作用的结果。虽然核心复制蛋白由病毒编码，但额外的细胞蛋白支持基因组合成的过程。我们采用加速天然分离新生DNA上的蛋白质（aniPOND）方法，研究HCMV感染期间新生病毒DNA上的蛋白质动态。利用该方法，我们鉴定了与新生病毒DNA相关的特定病毒和细胞蛋白，包括转录因子、转录调控因子、DNA损伤与修复因子以及染色质重塑复合物。通过免疫荧光成像、染色质免疫沉淀分析和shRNA敲低实验，确认了这些鉴定出的蛋白质与病毒DNA的关联。这些数据为HCMV复制中细胞因子的需求提供了证据。
